tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. The webhook trigger needs no credentials; if a MAKE_API_TOKEN is configured, validates it against the Make account API. For full scenario management, the token should have scopes: scenarios:read, scenarios:write, teams:read, organizations:read.

tools.name: trigger-webhook
tools.description: Trigger a Make.com scenario by POSTing a JSON payload to its webhook URL. No account token required — the user supplies the webhook URL (https://hook.<region>.make.com/<token>). Returns { delivered, statusCode, webhookHost, region, responseType, response }.

webhookUrl.description: The Make.com webhook URL (https://hook.<region>.make.com/<token>). Only *.make.com hosts over https are accepted.

payload.description: Body sent to the webhook. A JSON object is sent as application/json; a string is forwarded as-is (JSON string → application/json, otherwise text/plain).

tools.name: list-scenarios
tools.description: List Make.com scenarios for the configured account (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Optionally filter by teamId and page with limit/offset. Returns { scenarios: [{ id, name, isActive, isPaused, teamId }], returned, total, offset, limit, hasMore, nextOffset, teamId, region }. When hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset to fetch the next page.

teamId.description: Make team id to scope the scenarios (found in the team URL). Required by the Make API on most accounts.

limit.description: Max scenarios to return per page (1-100, default 50).

offset.description: Number of scenarios to skip for pagination (default 0). Pass the `nextOffset` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

includeRaw.description: Include the unprocessed upstream scenario rows under `raw` for debugging (default false).

tools.name: run-scenario
tools.description: Run a Make.com scenario on demand by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Pass optional `data` for the run inputs and `responsive: true` to wait for and return its outputs. Returns { scenarioId, executionId, status, responsive, outputs }.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to run (from list-scenarios).

data.description: Optional input data passed to the scenario run.

responsive.description: If true, wait for the run to finish and return its outputs (default false).

tools.name: create-scenario
tools.description: Create a new Make.com scenario (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). The `blueprint` is provided as a JSON object and is serialized internally. Returns { scenarioId, name, teamId, folderId, isActive, region, url }. Some Make plans require a paid subscription to use this endpoint.

teamId.description: Make team id that will own the scenario.

blueprint.description: Scenario blueprint as a JSON object (not an escaped string). It will be serialized to a string before sending to Make.

scheduling.description: Scheduling configuration. Defaults to { type: "indefinitely", interval: 60 }.

folderId.description: Optional folder id to place the scenario in.

confirmed.description: Whether the scenario is confirmed on creation (default true).

basedon.description: Optional id of an existing scenario to base this one on.

tools.name: get-scenario
tools.description: Get a single Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Returns the scenario object as returned by Make.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to retrieve.

tools.name: get-scenario-blueprint
tools.description: Get the blueprint of a Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Returns { scenarioId, blueprint } where blueprint is a parsed JSON object when possible.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario whose blueprint to retrieve.

tools.name: update-scenario
tools.description: Update an existing Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Supports updating name, blueprint (as a JSON object), scheduling, and folderId. Returns the updated scenario summary.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to update.

blueprint.description: New scenario blueprint as a JSON object (not an escaped string). It will be serialized to a string before sending to Make.

folderId.description: New folder id for the scenario.

tools.name: delete-scenario
tools.description: Delete a Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). This action is irreversible. Returns { scenarioId, deleted, region }.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to delete.

tools.name: clone-scenario
tools.description: Clone an existing Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Optionally set a new name or folder. Returns the cloned scenario summary.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to clone.

name.description: Optional new name for the cloned scenario.

folderId.description: Optional folder id for the cloned scenario.

tools.name: start-scenario
tools.description: Activate (start) a Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Returns { scenarioId, isActive, region }.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to activate.

tools.name: stop-scenario
tools.description: Pause (stop) a Make.com scenario by id (requires MAKE_API_TOKEN in user secrets). Returns { scenarioId, isActive, region }.

scenarioId.description: The id of the scenario to pause.
